meta.title: Jujutsu (jj) tools
meta.description: jj-native model tools: status, log, diff, new, commit, describe, commit-style detection, squash, amend (fold a correction into an unpushed commit), abandon (drop unpublished revisions), undo/op log/op restore, fetch, workspace and stale recovery, bookmark, rebase, plus a one-call hand-off integration and cleanup of the workspace this session created.
